# A second entry with the UID of one in the same calendar: 409
# no-uid-conflict with the href of the entry that has it; nothing written.
# Another calendar may hold the same UID.
@seed calendar privat first.ics dentist.ics
@collection calendar arbeit Arbeit

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/second.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: dentist-moved.ics
< status 409
< error cal:no-uid-conflict
< body-has <d:href>/caldav/alex/calendars/privat/first.ics</d:href>

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/second.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404

> PUT /caldav/alex/calendars/arbeit/second.ics
> Auth: alex
> Content-Type: text/calendar; charset=utf-8
> If-None-Match: *
> Body: dentist-moved.ics
< status 201
